content: Tailscale Funnel lifecycle: enable with 'tailscale funnel <port>', disable with 'tailscale funnel <port> off', reset all with 'tailscale funnel reset'. Background persistence with -bg flag; survives reboots. Prerequisites: Tailscale v1.38.3+, MagicDNS enabled, HTTPS certificates configured, nodeAttrs funnel in tailnet policy file. Only ports 443, 8443, 10000 supported. TLS only. Default nodeAttrs allows all autogroup:member. Funnel relay servers do NOT decrypt traffic (end-to-end encrypted). Funnel and Serve cannot share the same port.
